falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 78% similarity to bottom_2024_aug pattern would be broken, as the August 2024 bottom featured no such recovery to pre-correction highs within two weeks; this would indicate a V-shaped recovery rather than a bottoming process, invalidating the pattern match

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX below 14 would signal complacency and risk-on normalization, contradicting the bottom_2024_aug analog which maintained elevated volatility (VIX 15-20+) during its 14-day bottoming phase; this would prove the market is not in a bottoming regime

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve steepens by more than 25 basis points from current levels within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with curve flattening/bear steepening dynamics; a rapid bull steepening of 25+ bps would signal recession panic rather than a controlled growth scare, breaking the macro conditions that defined the 2024 August bottom and thus invalidating the pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
